title: Quantifying context-dependent outcomes of the interaction between Silene stellata and its pollinating seed predator Hadena ectypa a potential mutualist
screening_reason: Dissertation Chapter 3 directly quantifies individual plant flowering-Hadena oviposition synchrony and follows marked flowers through fruit initiation and flower/fruit predation in 2008-2009, but fruit initiation and predation are modeled separately and no single synchrony-to-final-net-female-fitness coefficient with variance has yet been recovered.
notes: Kula 2012 PhD dissertation. Synchrony had no detectable effect on initiated fruit set in either year; synchrony increased predation in 2008 but decreased predation in 2009. Independent non-fig mixed strict bridge candidate.
